title: Glass Shelf 16-Inch Triple Tier Wall-Mounted | Solid Brass Hardware | Glass Shelf | Allied Brass
description:
Make your vanity area feel organized and open with a wall-mounted glass shelf that adds vertical storage without taking up counter space. This triple tier bathroom shelf (also called a wall shelf or floating shelf) keeps toiletries and daily essentials within easy reach while matching modern bathroom hardware and contemporary bath accessories.

Highlights:
- Create three storage levels at the sink with a triple tier glass shelf design
- Rely on strength for everyday items with 3/8-inch thick tempered glass and solid brass construction hardware
- Keep a clean, minimalist bathroom look with concealed screw mounting for a wall hanging, wall mount install
- Choose the look that fits your space with multiple designer finish options

Specs & Installation:
- Glass dimensions: 16 x 5 inches
- Overall size: 16 in (L) x 5 in (W) x 15 in (H)
- Glass thickness: 0.38 in (3/8 in)
- Weight capacity: 6 lb
- Mounting type: wall mount / wall-mounted with concealed screws
- Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4
- Assembly required: false
- Included: glass shelf and all installation hardware
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
